Method of Attack: Steals cryptocurrencies by manipulating the system clipboard to substitute the destination wallet address with one belonging to the attacker

Logs keystrokes, accesses the host's clipboard, conducts disk scans to uncover credentials and other valuable data, transmits gathered information to its Command and Control (C2) server through various communication channels including HTTP(S), SMTP, FTP, or even dispatching it to a designated Telegram channel
Collects sensitive data, establishes communications with its C2 server, and downloads additional files from the server to execute keylogging or password recovery functions on compromised devices
Attack Vector: Phishing emails containing a Word document with an embedded malicious link
Persistence through copying itself to startup directories and registry entries
Downloaded from specified URLs and executed using various methods
